    N = 14
    x = [-1] * N
    count = [0] * N  # count[v] = times v appears so far, v=0 to 13
    x[11] = 0

    # since x[11]=0, cannot have any 11, so 11 cannot appear, same for 12
    # so when choosing, avoid setting to 11 or 12
    def consistent(pos):
        rem = N - 1 - pos  # remaining after this pos? No, call after assign, so remaining after this assignment is N - pos -1
        for k in range(pos + 1):  # all assigned k <= pos
            if x[k] == -1: continue
            target = x[k]
            if count[k] > target or count[k] + rem < target:
                return False
        return True
    def bt(pos):
        if pos == N:
            # final check, but with rem=0 should be covered
            return True
        if x[pos] != -1:  # fixed
            v = x[pos]
            if v == 11 or v == 12: return False  # but we set 0
            if v < 0 or v >= N: return False
            count[v] += 1
            if consistent(pos):
                if bt(pos + 1):
                    return True
            count[v] -= 1
            return False
        # not fixed, try possible v
        for v in range(N):  # 0 to 13
            if v == 11 or v == 12: continue  # cannot appear
            x[pos] = v
            count[v] += 1
            if consistent(pos):
                if bt(pos + 1):
                    return True
            count[v] -= 1
            x[pos] = -1
        return False
    if bt(0):
        return x
    else:
        return "UNSATISFIABLE"
